blocks.text: TUGUEGARAO CITY – University of Cagayan Valley, Inc. (UCV), one of the Cagayan Valley‘s oldest educational institutions has been rocked by a leadership dispute among the stockholders. University officials, however, said they remain “committed to institutional integrity, peace and stability within its academic community” and will ensure “continued delivery” of quality education. UCV President Esther Susan Perez-Mari said in a statement on Tuesday that the university’s responsibility “extends beyond leadership positions or internal disagreements.” “Its foremost obligation is to protect an educational institution built through years of dedication and service, and to safeguard the interests and future of students,” she said.
